research_question: Can the frozen Native-60m rv_rel__raw score be converted into an interpretable causal NORMAL / UNSAFE / RECOVERING state process with non-degenerate occupancy and stable prospective next-bar intrabar-risk separation?

frozen_score_semantics.baseline: median of previous same-slot observations only
frozen_score_semantics.formula: score_t = intrabar_rv_1m_t / median(previous 60 finite intrabar_rv_1m observations from the same AM1/AM2/PM1/PM2 slot)
frozen_score_semantics.interpretation: score 1.0 equals the recent same-slot median path-volatility level

causal_state_machine.initial_scored_state: UNSAFE if score >= U else NORMAL
causal_state_machine.normal_rule: from NORMAL, score >= U -> UNSAFE; otherwise remain NORMAL
causal_state_machine.unsafe_rule: from UNSAFE, score >= U -> UNSAFE; score <= N -> NORMAL; otherwise -> RECOVERING
causal_state_machine.recovering_rule: from RECOVERING, score >= U -> UNSAFE; score <= N -> NORMAL; otherwise remain RECOVERING
causal_state_machine.unscored_rule: warmup bars are UNSCORED and do not receive imputed state
causal_state_machine.carry_policy: after scoring begins, prior state carries across lunch and overnight until the next scored bar close updates it
causal_state_machine.current_score_override: score >= U always sets UNSAFE and score <= N always sets NORMAL
causal_state_machine.overnight_selection_policy: overnight transitions and next-AM1 diagnostics are reported separately and cannot determine C2 selection

primary_evaluation.prospective_pair: current scored state to immediately following Native-60m bar within the same trading day only

candidate_diagnostics: scored/state row counts and shares overall, by year, and by slot
next-bar intrabar_rv_1m mean/median by current state overall and by year
next-bar phase60b-q90 intrabar-RV event probability by current state overall and by year
UNSAFE/NORMAL next-bar intrabar-RV mean ratio overall and by year
overall prospective ordering across UNSAFE, RECOVERING, NORMAL
same-day state transition matrix and UNSAFE persistence-to-UNSAFE-or-RECOVERING
state episode lengths overall and within trading day
current phase60b-q90/q95 path-energy capture by UNSAFE and UNSAFE-or-RECOVERING
secondary PM2 to next-day AM1 transition matrix and next-AM1 intrabar-RV by PM2 state

selection_rule.eligible: candidate must satisfy every mechanism gate
selection_rule.if_none: status=NATIVE60_STATE_HYSTERESIS_INSUFFICIENT; no selected state definition; Phase 60-C3 not authorized
if_one_or_more: maximize the minimum yearly UNSAFE/NORMAL next-bar intrabar-RV mean ratio
then maximize overall UNSAFE/NORMAL next-bar intrabar-RV mean ratio
then minimize max-minus-min UNSAFE share across AM1/AM2/PM1/PM2
then prefer unsafe entry threshold closest to 1.50
then prefer normal exit threshold closest to 1.00
selection_rule.selected_state_authority: development state-definition candidate only; it is not holdout-validated, calibrated probability, trading, or production authority

descriptive_not_gating: state episode-length distribution beyond the frozen persistence gate

next_phase_contract.on_complete: may preregister Phase 60-C3 using the frozen selected score and frozen selected U/N state definition on the previously sealed 2024-2025 repeat-audit holdout; no development retuning is allowed
next_phase_contract.on_insufficient: Phase 60-C3 remains blocked; no post-result threshold-grid expansion or gate relaxation under this task identity
